u0: Initial state before the box has been picked up; the box is not held. Current objective: locate and pick up the box. The first step that ends with holding_box at a non-exit cell moves to u1 and earns the initial 0.1 reward. Reaching the exit without the box goes to failure u5.
u1: The first pickup has succeeded and the box is normally in hand, with no fall yet in this RM history. Current objective: carry the box to the exit while keeping possession. A fall moves to the immediate-recovery state u2, while reaching the exit without the box moves to failure u5.
u2: The first fall has just occurred: the box is on the floor and not held. Immediate subtask: on the very next step, be positioned and facing so that a successful pickup can be made. A successful re-pickup at a non-exit cell moves to recovered-carrying state u3 and earns the 0.2 recovery reward; any next step that ends without holding the box and without a new fall moves to failure u5.
u3: Recovered carrying state: the box has fallen at least once and has been picked up again, so it is back in hand and there is no pending immediate pickup. Current objective: continue to the exit while holding it. Another fall moves to u4 for another immediate recovery; reaching the exit without the box moves to failure u5.
u4: A later fall has occurred: the box is again on the floor and not held. Immediate subtask: perform a successful pickup on the very next step, requiring the agent to be correctly positioned and facing. A successful re-pickup returns to recovered-carrying state u3 and earns the 0.2 recovery reward; if the next step ends without holding the box and without another fall, the agent enters absorbing failure u5.
u5: Absorbing failure state: the box was not recovered when required, or the agent reached the exit without the box in hand. No further progress or success reward is possible; subsequent actions keep the agent in this failed state.
u6: Final success state: the agent has reached the exit while holding the box. The box-related objective is complete and the full success reward has been obtained; this is an absorbing final state.
